summary: Frozen since 2019 and carries lodash's ongoing advisory stream. Prototype pollution was fixed in 4.6.2, but there is no path to future fixes.
reasoning: Last release July 2019; lodash itself carries six advisories on 4.17.15, including two 2026 CVEs.
Versions before 4.6.2 are vulnerable to GHSA-h726-x36v-rx45 (high).
No provenance attestation and no bundled types; requires @types/lodash.merge.
Copies inherited enumerable properties and merges arrays by index, which surprises most callers.
caveats: If lodash is already a hard dependency, importing merge adds no new package, but the maintenance and behaviour issues remain.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 4.6.2 published 2019-07-10; no release in seven years.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: GHSA-h726-x36v-rx45 (prototype pollution) fixed in 4.6.2. The parent lodash package has six advisories on 4.17.15 including CVE-2026-2950 and CVE-2026-4800.

evidence.label: Runtime behaviour
evidence.detail: Copies inherited enumerable properties; array merge is index-based; deep recursion overflows the stack.
